decision: Do not initiate at this price; keep on watch — NVIDIA (NVDA) for the buy-side investment committee (no current position)
units: USD millions; per-share values in USD
share_basis: 24,100m shares outstanding (10-Q cover, 21 Aug 2026) + 95m dilutive award increment (Q2 FY2027 Note 4) = 24,195m diluted
recommendation: Do not initiate at this price; keep on watch: value per share $80 (low) / $124 (base) / $187 (high) against $225.51. Initiate only if the price falls below the base case ($124) with the checks still passing, or if two quarterly reports move the growth path enough to lift the high case above the price. Hold the watch posture while Data Center revenue keeps growing quarter on quarter and gross margin guidance stays at or above 72%.
reversal_trigger: Data Center revenue, quarter on quarter: any decline (next two quarterly reports (Nov 2026, Feb 2027)) → withdraw the base case and rebuild as the low case (about $80); Gross margin guidance: below 72% and falling (next two quarterly reports) → move the gross-margin path down 3 pp (about -$12 at base); Operating expenses vs revenue: opex growing faster than revenue for two quarters (next two quarterly reports) → opex path +2 pp (about -$5 at base); Enterprise-to-equity bridge: fails to reconcile after the next 10-Q (new debt, buybacks, securities) (each filing) → reject the per-share conclusion until the bridge reconciles
committee_ask: Approve watch/defer: no position now; authorise a re-review within one week of the Q3 FY2027 report with the tool re-run on the new filing.
monitoring_owner: the analyst (this tool re-run on each filing); sector analysts own the demand view

High — the compute cycle keeps compounding and CUDA holds price

sensitivity_ranking.driver: Operating expenses / revenue, shift (pp, all years)

limitations: The model values the equity at the pro-forma opening date (25 Jan 2026) with all FY2027E cash flows ahead; the 23 Sep 2026 price is eight months later. Rolling the value forward at the cost of equity would add about 8% before the distributions paid since (about 1% of value).
FY2027E is a 53-week year (14-week Q4); the base carries the extra week into later years (about -$2 per share if normalised).
SBC is added back as a non-cash charge; the toggle shows the cash-cost alternative.
The $24.9bn of notes issued in June 2026 sit outside the opening balance sheet; they change the bridge only through timing, which the consistent (Jan 2026) bridge avoids.
Peer multiples use trailing GAAP figures; both peers carry large acquired-intangible amortisation, which depresses their GAAP earnings and inflates their multiples.
